__comment: virtu deliverability — how the big receivers are treating our IP. Import into Grafana (Dashboards → New → Import) against the Prometheus datasource Alloy ships maild's :9100 metrics to (alloy/config.alloy, compose profile `observe`). Every series here is emitted by server/src/metrics/index.ts; the per-destination ones come from queue/worker.ts + queue/destinationThrottle.ts.
title: virtu · deliverability

panels.title: Destinations paused now
panels.description: Recipient domains the per-destination throttle is holding back (queue/destinationThrottle.ts). Anything above 0 on gmail/microsoft/yahoo means that receiver told us to back off within the last pause window.

panels.title: Deferral rate (all providers, 1h)
panels.description: Share of delivery attempts answered 4xx over the last hour. A cold IP sits near 0; a rise here precedes a pause.

panels.title: Mailboxes suppressed (24h)
panels.description: First-strike 5.1.1/5.2.1 suppressions (ABUSE.md Tier 1). Each one is a dead mailbox we stopped bouncing into.

panels.title: Delivery outcomes by provider
panels.description: virtu_queue_destination_deliveries_total — sent / transient (4xx, retried) / permanent (5xx, bounced) per provider bucket. The shape to watch: transient climbing on one provider while sent stays flat.

panels.title: How angry is each receiver — failed replies by code
panels.description: virtu_queue_destination_replies_total — every failed attempt by provider × SMTP reply code. 421 = the receiver closed the door on us (rate/reputation); 450/451 = try later (greylisting, busy); 550 = refused outright. Enhanced class.subject is in the legend: 4.7 = policy (reputation-shaped), 4.2 = mailbox (recipient-shaped), 5.1 = no such user.

panels.title: Pauses triggered and rows held back
panels.description: virtu_destination_pauses_total (a receiver said back off) vs virtu_queue_destination_deferred_total (rows we did NOT attempt because of it). The second line is the damage the throttle prevented.

panels.title: Failed replies by SMTP step
panels.description: Where in the conversation receivers stop us. greeting/ehlo = connection-level (IP reputation, connection limits); mail_from = sender-level (SPF/DMARC/return-path); rcpt_to = recipient-level (unknown user, greylisting); data = content-level (spam filtering).

panels.title: Inbound pressure we refused
panels.description: virtu_mx_rate_limited_total — RCPTs tempfailed 450 by the per-alias / per-mailbox inbound rate limit (pipeline/inboundRateLimit.ts), i.e. floods kept on the sender's side of the wire instead of becoming our outbound burst. Plus DSNs withheld from flagged (unauthenticated) senders.

panels.title: Queue depth and oldest due
panels.description: virtu_queue_depth by status + virtu_queue_oldest_pending_age_seconds. A pause shows up as pending rising while sending stays flat — expected; the throttle is the thing holding them.
